findings.statement: The supplied analytical proof establishes the exact single-instance claim. Substitution into the thirty rhombus inequalities gives the stated three-dimensional polytope P. The identity on x >= z and the determinant-one shear U(x,y,z)=(x,y+x-z,z) on x < z have disjoint images forming the displayed convex polytope Q. Its vertices are integral: the sole nonintegral candidate w becomes the midpoint of (1,0,0) and (0,-1,1). The four-tetrahedron triangulation, including each distinct face's relative interior once, supplies the required finite simplex partition. Integral translation and block-diagonal extension give affine unimodular maps in R^6.
